title: How Many Triangles?
summary: Count by size: small first, then combinations, then the whole.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A big triangle has a line drawn from the top corner to the middle of the bottom side.
How many triangles are in the picture?
points: A big triangle has a line drawn from the top corner to the middle of the bottom side.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Count by size. First the small triangles, then bigger ones made from two or more.
points: Count by size. First the small triangles, then bigger ones made from two or more.

steps.title: The method: Count systematically
sentences: The line splits the big triangle into 2 small triangles.
The big triangle itself is a third.
Do not forget to count the whole shape.
points: The line splits the big triangle into 2 small triangles.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: There are 3 triangles: 2 small and 1 big.
Counting small, then joined, then whole avoids missing any.
points: There are 3 triangles: 2 small and 1 big.

quiz.q: A square is cut by both diagonals. How many triangles can you find, counting those made of two small ones?
quiz.why: 4 small triangles plus 4 larger ones made of two each give 8.
